sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Module setup and imports
sections.what: Loads the helpers for pattern matching, counting and averages, and describes the module as a schedule estimator.
sections.why: These helpers are needed by the calculations below.

sections.name: GovernanceCalculator (part 1)
sections.title: Creating the calculator and starting the estimate
sections.what: Stores the RAG engine and the verbose setting. The main estimate searches past proposals, reads their meeting patterns, and then calculates the SteerCo and weekly schedules.
sections.why: Likely reason: the calculator needs past evidence before it can estimate anything.
sections.watch_out: Workstreams are read by their name attribute, so each item in the list must be an object that has a name.

sections.name: GovernanceCalculator (part 2)
sections.title: Assembling the result and finding similar projects
sections.what: Packs the two schedules and the evidence count into one result. The similar-project search asks the RAG engine for governance and meeting text, then keeps only passages that mention SteerCo, steering, governance or meeting.
sections.why: Likely reason: the similar-project search supplies the raw evidence the rest of the calculation depends on.
sections.watch_out: Good evidence phrased with other words is dropped, because only four keywords pass the filter.

sections.name: GovernanceCalculator: _extract_steerco_patterns
sections.title: Reading SteerCo frequency
sections.what: Scans each past project's text for how often the SteerCo meets, such as bi-weekly, fortnightly or monthly, or a stated number of weeks.
sections.why: Turns free-form proposal wording into numbers the calculation can use.
sections.watch_out: Only the first matching frequency phrase in each project is used, and phrases in unrelated sentences can match.

sections.name: GovernanceCalculator (part 4)
sections.title: Reading meeting counts, lengths and weekly meetings
sections.what: Finds the stated number of SteerCo meetings (kept only between 2 and 20) and project lengths in weeks (4 to 52, with months converted to weeks). It also counts projects that mention weekly meetings.
sections.why: Likely reason: the range limits discard numbers that are unlikely to be meeting counts or project lengths.
sections.watch_out: Meeting counts and lengths are stored in separate lists, so a project's length can be paired with another project's meeting count.

sections.name: GovernanceCalculator: _calculate_steerco_schedule
sections.title: Estimating the SteerCo meeting count
sections.what: Turns the evidence into a SteerCo meeting count using the median of past length-to-meeting ratios, falling back to frequency when that is not possible. It then keeps the count within a reasonable range and prints the working when verbose.
sections.why: Likely reason: a median limits the effect of one unusual past project.
sections.watch_out: Because the pairing is by list position, one misaligned pair can shift the whole estimate.

sections.name: GovernanceCalculator (part 6)
sections.title: Building the SteerCo result and weekly schedule
sections.what: Returns the SteerCo result (count, frequency, description and evidence count) and the weekly schedule. The weekly schedule always equals the project length in weeks.
sections.why: Likely reason: weekly meetings are assumed by design, and the historical share is shown only for information.
sections.watch_out: The weekly count is not checked against the evidence, so it stays at one per week even if past projects rarely held weekly meetings.

sections.name: GovernanceCalculator: _describe_cadence
sections.title: Turning a frequency into plain words
sections.what: Converts a frequency in weeks into a label such as Weekly, Bi-weekly, Monthly, or Every N weeks. It also prints the summary of the results when verbose.
sections.why: So readers see a label such as Bi-weekly rather than a decimal number.
sections.watch_out: The ranges are fixed, so a frequency just outside a range gets the generic Every N weeks label.

summary: Estimates how many Steering Committee (SteerCo) meetings and weekly meetings a project should have, using patterns found in similar past proposals.
purpose: Suggest a governance meeting plan for a new proposal, with a count of the evidence behind it.
why: Likely reason: so the meeting plan reflects what similar past projects did rather than a guess. The module docstring states this.
how: Search past proposals for governance text, pull out meeting frequency, meeting counts and project lengths, then estimate the number of SteerCo meetings. Weekly meetings are set to one per project week.
inputs: A list of workstream objects (each needs a name), the project length in weeks, and a RAG engine for searching past proposals.
outputs: A dictionary with a SteerCo entry (total meetings, frequency, description, evidence count), a weekly entry, and the number of similar projects found.
risks: Weekly meetings always equal the project length, regardless of evidence. SteerCo lengths and meeting counts are paired by list position, not by source project. With no evidence, a bi-weekly default is used without any warning in the result.
debug: Turn on verbose to see the count of historical data points. A count of zero means the search found no governance text, so check the query, the indexed proposals and the RAG engine.
